# Pane SDK context fixture

This test-only plugin is installed through the real preview, consent, and install
API, then opened through a server-issued Project Pane occurrence in both direct
and placed hosts. Its renderer consumes genuine public Agent, navigation, toast,
and plugin-identity SDK contexts. It is not a first-party example migration and
does not declare global actions, a default Agent, or execution authority.

The example migration remains owned by
[Station issue 265](https://github.com/kontourai/station/issues/265), with exact
global-action/default-Agent semantics in
[issue 1372](https://github.com/kontourai/station/issues/1372). No example or
persisted Layout is converted by this fixture.
